rows: Remove the front cover of the relay.
Disconnect terminals T5:44, 46 inside cell 1PRP to prevent disabling the generator cooling water system.
Clean the relay of dust using an air blower, taking care not to direct the air at the springs.
Lower the links inside the relay numbered (4, 5, 6, 7).
Connect the circuit as shown in the attached figure.
Set the angle measuring instrument selector to the Lead position.
Connect the current injection leads to points (6, 7) on the relay (32G) as in the explanatory figure.
Connect the voltage injection leads to points (4, 5) on the relay (32G) as in the explanatory figure.
Raise the current gradually until you can read the phase difference between voltage and current.
Set the angle to 30 degrees (voltage on Input and current on Reference).
Raise the current gradually until the disc of element 32G starts to move.
Record the current value at which the disc of element 32G starts to move.
Set the injection current to the value given in the attached table.
Change the phase angle between voltage and current in the LAG direction until the 32G disc moves.
Change the phase angle between voltage and current in the LEAD direction until the 32G disc moves.
Repeat steps 16 to 21, setting the current to the value given in the attached table.
Measuring the voltage value at which element T operates
Latch the disc of element 32G (manually) until element S operates.
Raise the voltage from 0 to the value at which disc T starts to move, while keeping element S operated.
Testing the time of element T
Connect the start points of the time counter to the start points of the PHU-100 voltage injector.
Connect the stop points of the time counter to points (2, 10) on the relay.
Reset the time setting to 6 instead of time dial 10.
Select the Dry Contact position on the time counter for both START & STOP.
Latch the disc of element 32G (manually) until the element operates.
Remove the wire leads from the relay.
Fit the front cover of the relay.

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the reverse power protection device of the main generator. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut New Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company. The field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 9 May 2005.
Safety Precautions
The unit is shut down and the generator is out of service.
Open a work order and ensure the availability of occupational safety and health cards.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Two (2) PHU-100 current and voltage injection test sets
Two (2) single-phase 400/200 V transformers, 1 kVA capacity
One (1) three-phase switch.
Avometer (Fluky 87).
Two (2) V-A AC current measuring instruments, model YOKOGAWA
Test leads
One (1) Digital Phase Meter KDK DPF-30N
One (1) Time Counter
Contact cleaning tools (Spray Crown-8276)
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Remove the front cover of the relay. | 1.
Disconnect terminals T5:44, 46 inside cell 1PRP to prevent disabling the generator cooling water system. | 2.
Clean the contacts using (Spray Crown-8276). | 3.
Clean the relay of dust using an air blower, taking care not to direct the air at the springs. | 4.
Lower the links inside the relay numbered (4, 5, 6, 7). | 5.
Connect the circuit as shown in the attached figure. | 6.
Set the angle measuring instrument selector to the Lead position. | 7.
Set the time dial to 10. | 8.
Measuring the Operating Value
Connect the current injection leads to points (6, 7) on the relay (32G) as in the explanatory figure. | 9.
Connect the voltage injection leads to points (4, 5) on the relay (32G) as in the explanatory figure. | 10.
Inject voltage of 110 V. | 11.
Raise the current gradually until you can read the phase difference between voltage and current. | 12.
Set the angle to 30 degrees (voltage on Input and current on Reference). | 13.
Raise the current gradually until the disc of element 32G starts to move. | 14.
Record the current value at which the disc of element 32G starts to move. | 15.
Characteristic Test
Inject 110 V. | 16.
Set the injection current to the value given in the attached table. | 17.
Change the phase angle between voltage and current in the LAG direction until the 32G disc moves. | 18.
Record the phase angle value. | 19.
Change the phase angle between voltage and current in the LEAD direction until the 32G disc moves. | 20.
Record the phase angle value. | 21.
Repeat steps 16 to 21, setting the current to the value given in the attached table. | 22.

Connect the start points of the time counter to the start points of the PHU-100 voltage injector. | 28.

uncertain_terms.note: Function code carries a stray leading 'x' ('x32G'); kept as written.
'للسست' rendered as 'springs' (Egyptian dialect 'السوست'); the source spelling is unclear.
'السكاكين' (literally 'knives') rendered as 'links', the relay link/knife-switch sense.
'لقط القرص' rendered as 'latch the disc'; the intended manual operation is not further specified in the source.
Stray '0' at the end of sections 8 and 14:2:0 looks like an OCR artefact; omitted.
Terminal notation 'T5:44,46' kept as written; the separator between the two terminals is unclear in the source.
